purpose: Held-out corpus pin for E1 (issue #315, goal #294); field names follow code-evidence-e1/dev-corpus-pin.json. The frozen manifest is not edited.
deviations_from_dev_corpus_pin: One entry per repository under 'repositories' (the dev pin holds one corpus).
Each fact carries value/status/source; status is measured, fetched, inferred, reported or unverified (the dev pin uses plain fields and notes).

status_vocabulary.measured: read directly from the production database by the cited read-only query
status_vocabulary.fetched: returned by a read-only GET or git command on the cited date
status_vocabulary.inferred: concluded from other evidence; not an observation of the thing itself
status_vocabulary.reported: stated by the repository owner; not independently checked
status_vocabulary.unverified: not established; no value is recorded
